rules: Generated civilizations need not belong to a major canonical faction.
Pre-warp contact status constrains Starfleet interaction.
Technology level constrains generated ships, facilities and detectable signatures.
Culture influences institutions and norms but does not prescribe every individual's personality.
Political alignment and species identity are separate.
Once materialized, civilization identity and history persist and evolve through campaign events.
Warp threshold triggers contact-readiness assessment rather than automatic contact.
Generated names, morphology, languages, governments and settlements materialize deterministically and persist.
Contact with one polity does not imply planet-wide recognition on politically divided worlds.
